opening.argument: The promotion presents a free automated Alien Worlds mining bot and directs viewers to obtain it through an external download. Its stated purpose is reward-oriented: the displayed interface shows a TLM balance, mining history, and an “Auto Claim NFTs” control, tying token and NFT functionality to the software. The instructions also tell viewers to “Disable / remove antivirus (files are completely clean)” and “Disable Windows Smart Screen” while installing it. These are strong indicators of a risky trading-bot or funded-contract returns promotion, although the frames do not establish whether the software works, is safe, or caused any loss.
